rationale.conceptual: The underlying method (DFT-LDA with VCA, norm-conserving pseudopotentials, BFGS relaxation) is an established multi-part protocol that requires correct implementation of pseudopotential mixing, parameter selection, and convergence criteria. rationale.execution: Real execution would involve constructing VCA pseudopotentials for each composition, writing ABINIT input files, running 10 independent geometry relaxations, extracting lattice constants, and post-processing. This is a multi-stage pipeline with non-trivial tool usage and data handoffs, though not excessively long or fragile.
